intelligence.human_view: A flat page asks the citizen to scroll through a wall and find what matters. An unfold asks one question at a time and answers it — a beat, a button, a reveal. The matrix is the shape of that: not a document, not a feed, a living system where each piece opens into the next and nothing is shown before its moment. The round-3 complaints are all the same complaint in different clothes: the Message button merging into the picture, the flat icons, the terrible pop-up, the flat About — every one is a place where the page stopped being an object and became a picture of an object. Real icons matter because every icon is an object; unfolds matter because every section is a moment. The law is not a style preference. It is the difference between a web page and the new internet.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a normal website is like a long flat road — you just walk and walk and everything is there at once, boring! But our pages are like a magic treasure box — you press a button and POP! A new part opens up, beautiful and alive! Each part opens when you want it, like a matrix — a whole living world that unfolds for you, one surprise at a time!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the old internet is a flat piece of paper you scroll and scroll. Ours is more like a beautiful pop-up book: you press, and a whole little world opens up for you, then the next one, then the next. About opens like a flower. Skills open like a flower. Nothing flat, nothing boring — everything opens when you ask it to, like magic.
intelligence.naya_view: Our pages will be unfolds, our slideshows. Not typical web pages, flat or just scroll down — do something different. Treat it more like a matrix.
